in_sanskrit.name: Unni
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Younger brother, god
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Unni एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Unni means younger brother in Malayalam and is also a name for the Hindu god Shiva. In Sanskrit, Unni is derived from the root 'un' which means new, and 'ni' meaning born.
